Read by bin/update-model-prices.sh as ${MODEL_SLUGS:-}. An explicit path to the model -> openrouter slug map, used AS GIVEN in place of catalog/model-slugs.json — the same seam $MODEL_PRICES is for the price table, and like it, an unreadable override falls back to the script constant rather than to a different file. Registered by BH-1361 so it is visible; NOT settable from the control plane — it is a path and a test seam a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it.

BH-3990. Read by bin/update-model-prices.sh as ${MODEL_PRICES_CATALOG_MAX_AGE_DAYS:-14}: when catalog/model-prices.json's updated_at is more than this many days old (or unreadable) the lane raises one warn lane-alert, id model-prices-catalog-stale, and resolves it once the catalog is within the threshold. Checked before the OpenRouter fetch, so a failed refresh cannot hide it. 0 = off; a non-integer is the default.
